module_summary: AXI-stream Ethernet FCS checker: a 2-state FSM delays bytes through a 4-stage shift register, updates a CRC32 LFSR child, strips the FCS and flags mismatches through a skid-buffered output.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PAYLOAD controller driving shift, CRC update and frame end handling

anchors.name: crc_state
anchors.why: Running CRC32 state fed to the LFSR child, reset per frame

anchors.name: crc_next
anchors.why: LFSR output compared against received FCS bytes to detect bad frames

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata_d0
anchors.why: Representative of 4-byte delay line holding trailing FCS bytes

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid_d3
anchors.why: Indicates delay line full; gates output valid and CRC update

anchors.name: update_crc
anchors.why: Enables loading crc_next into crc_state

anchors.name: shift_in
anchors.why: Advances data and valid delay-line registers on accepted beat

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input stream byte entering delay line

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input beat valid qualifying shift and state transitions

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready from s_axis_tready_reg, backpressured by output

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of frame marker triggering FCS comparison and FSM return

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream byte with FCS stripped

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from skid buffer register

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling skid buffer transfers

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Output frame error flag, set on bad FCS

anchors.name: error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Pulse reporting a frame failed FCS check

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Level indicating frame in progress (state not idle)

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp slot valid, holding beat when output stalled

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready selecting output or temp store paths

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads internal beat into output registers

groups.name: FCS check controller
groups.description: FSM sequencing delay-line shift, CRC update and end-of-frame comparison

groups.name: CRC datapath
groups.description: CRC32 state register with LFSR child computing next CRC per byte

groups.name: FCS delay line
groups.description: Four-byte shift register holding candidate FCS bytes

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output and temp registers decoupling m_axis ready from input ready

groups.name: Stream interfaces
groups.description: AXI-stream input and output ports plus status
